description: This file defines constants, enums, and data structures related to accounting for different financial products (loans, savings, shares) in the Fineract project. It includes account type mappings, parameter names, and financial activity definitions.

classes.name: AccountingConstants
classes.description: Contains enums and constants for accounting account types, parameters, and financial activities used across the Fineract accounting module.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding enum value for account types or financial activities.

methods.name: getAllFinancialActivities
methods.description: Returns a list of all financial activity data objects.

methods.name: toFinancialActivityData
methods.description: Converts a financial activity ID to its corresponding FinancialActivityData object.
